beats.text: Which homology classes of $Q_0S^0$ come from actual maps of spheres?
Curtis: only $\eta, \nu, \sigma$ and the Kervaire-invariant-one classes $\theta_j$
So the positive image vanishes outside these nine degrees

steps: Suppose some other class came from a map of spheres
Follow it through a chain of related maps, one level at a time
It would force a pattern the algebra forbids: impossible
